newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian crude palm oil firmer in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian crude palm oil firmer in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian crude palm prices were firmer in late trading on Friday following a tender in the north Sumatran city in Medan, traders said.
One trader in Medan said crude palm oil prices improved in the afternoon after a 500-tonne tender was achieved at 1,165 rupiah/kg, compared with early tender at 1,159.75 rupiah/kg.
"Prices seem to have hit the bottom. This may explain the recovery," one trader said. Sentiment was weak before the late tender as prices were on a downtrend.
Previous tender prices were 1,161 and 1,173 rupiah/kg.
Traders said palm olein prices, however, was still weak, with prices quoted at 1,370/75 rupiah/kg in Jakarta.
